name: Town Line Plaza
summary: Town Line Plaza is a 206,246 square foot suburban retail center anchored by a state-of-the-art Stop & Shop Supermarket, strategically located at I-91 and Route 99 in Rocky Hill, Connecticut. Serving the Hartford MSA, the center offers convenient access for residents of Rocky Hill and Wethersfield with available retail space.
demographics: Town Line Plaza serves a diverse suburban demographic in the Hartford MSA, drawing primarily from Rocky Hill and Wethersfield with a mix of middle to upper-middle income families and professionals. The trade area benefits from its proximity to I-91 and Route 99, attracting commuters and residents from the greater Hartford metropolitan area who seek convenient access to everyday shopping needs. The center's anchor tenant, Stop & Shop Supermarket, drives consistent foot traffic from households focused on grocery shopping and routine errands, with typical visitors ranging from young families to established homeowners in the 30-65 age range.
description: Town Line Plaza is a well-positioned suburban retail center located at the strategic intersection of I-91 and Silas Deane Highway (Route 99) in Rocky Hill, Connecticut, just five miles south of Hartford. Situated on the town line between Rocky Hill and Wethersfield, this 206,246 square foot shopping center serves as a convenient retail destination for the greater Hartford MSA. The property has undergone significant redevelopment, highlighted by a state-of-the-art Stop & Shop Supermarket that serves as the center's primary anchor tenant. The plaza's location provides excellent accessibility for both local residents and commuters traveling along the I-91 corridor, making it a natural stop for everyday shopping needs. With available retail space and a strong grocery anchor, Town Line Plaza continues to serve the community as a reliable neighborhood shopping destination in Connecticut's capital region.
